name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-viva-engage-explorer
title: Viva Engage Community Explorer
shortDescription: Discover, search and explore live Viva Engage communities inside Microsoft 365 Copilot.
longDescription: A read-only SPFx Copilot UX Component using delegated Microsoft Graph Community.Read.All access.
Includes inline and fullscreen experiences, name and description search, privacy filtering, alphabetical sorting, retrieved community counts and on-demand details.
Uses live Graph data only, with pagination, session caching, explicit refresh and actionable authentication and API error states.
